name: Idaho Summer B 2021
information:
# Registration is now closed and the waitlist is full.
**This is a Twin Competition with [Idaho Summer A 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IdahoSummerA2021). You may only compete in one of the two competitions. Please look at the [Twin Competitions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IdahoSummerB2021#15781-twin-competitions) tab.**

**Competitors may have at most one spectator/guest attend with them. Please do not attend if you have any symptoms of COVID-19**

Please be sure to familiarize yourself with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), the WCA [Competition Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), and our [Risk Management Plan](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1veNWzPcM9sTuWmuBfvyzVbQxbvoNDuIZ-0w6SAyFbz4/edit?usp=sharing) for this competition.

Most competitors will be expected to be a judge or runner.
 Please look through the [Judging and Running](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IdahoSummerB2021#15780-judging-and-running) and [Competing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IdahoSummerB2021#15779-competing) tabs before registering.

Competitors are encouraged to bring their own pens.

Please make sure you are familiar with all of the WCA regulations. There will be a compeitor tutorial at 9:00 AM on Saturday.
